_commentaire: TEST manifest, to validate macdeploy on a Mac without deploying anything.
Targets TextEdit: present on every Mac, harmless to close, and its bundle ID
is stable. No `detection` block: without it, `pre` never short-circuits and
always goes through the gate, which is precisely what we are testing.
No `payload` block either: nothing will be installed.
Deliberately short delays so the tests don't make you wait:
With forceCloseWhenExhausted set to true, the deferrable dialog already
carries its own countdown (60 s here) and installs on expiry: persistPromptSeconds
and maxDialogSeconds therefore do not apply. Set forceCloseWhenExhausted to
false to test persistence and the dialog budget.
